svg.title: The management group tree and where policy lands
svg.desc: Under the tenant root group, lab-az305-20-landing-zone-root holds -platform, -landingzones and -sandbox, with -corp and -online under -landingzones. The lz-baseline initiative is assigned at -landingzones, so -corp and -online inherit it; sandbox-no-pip denies public IP addresses in -sandbox. Your subscription stays outside the tree, so nothing is evaluated.
